description: This PHP source file defines the I18NTranslationAPI class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It implements an API endpoint for listing internationalization (i18n) translations, including filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters. The class extends a base Endpoint class and utilizes traits for localization services. It handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve translations data and integrates OpenAPI annotations for documentation.
